These efforts drove a solid year-end performance, with total revenue in Q4 returned to growth both annually and sequentially. Notably, our long-form dramas secured number one in viewership market share on Enlightent Data annual rankings, with five titles exceeding 10,000 for the iQIYI popularity score. More importantly, we have made remarkable breakthroughs in IP franchise development, moving beyond making individual hit titles to building our brand IPs that drive growth across diverse formats. Revenue will primarily come from ticket sales and on-site spending. Looking ahead, we aim to position iQIYI Lab as a key sales channel for IP-based consumer products, and a vital platform for maximizing the long-term value of our IP portfolio. First, we are strengthening our domestic core by enhancing the quality of original content, strengthening membership, and advertising businesses. Second, we will aim to sustain strong growth in our overseas and experience business, building more robust engines for long-term expansion.
